data.answer: Production data is deleted by dropping the customer's tenant schema and the associated storage objects. Encrypted volumes are retired by deleting their encryption keys.
For a severity-1 (P1) incident, which means customer data exposed or full outage, the acknowledgment time is within 15 minutes.
The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.

Company laptops are issued with mobile device management (MDM) installed and disk encryption enforced. The provided chunks do not explicitly mention whether staff access policyholder data from personal laptops or phones.
When a breach involving customer data is confirmed, affected customers are notified within 72 hours.
Yes, the current sub-processor list is shared with customers on request.
New hires must complete security awareness training within 7 days of joining.

We commit to a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 1 hour (at most one hour of data can be lost) and a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours (service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster).
Shared secrets that the departing employee had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
The provided chunks do not mention ISO 22301 business continuity certification. They only state that Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report and plans ISO 27001 certification for 2027.
